newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH RADIOLINJA HAS H1 OP PROFIT, SALES SOAR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH RADIOLINJA HAS H1 OP PROFIT, SALES SOAR.

text.p: Finnish mobile phone network operator Radiolinja Oy said on Wednesday its first-half sales rose 115 percent to 472.3 million markka and it booked a profit before extraordinaries of 31.8 million markka against a 19.2 million loss in the year-ago period.
The rise in net sales was due to growth both in the number of subscribers and in the usage of its nation-wide GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) service, it said.
Radiolinja said the number of subscribers had exceeded 400,000 but gave no comparison.
"The GSM mobile phone markets in Finland are expected to continue to grow strongly in Finland," Radiolinja managing director Pertti Malva said in the statement.
"The company's earnings trend will remain favourable," he said.
